context.exploration_scope: Final combined operational-readiness confirmation for both recorded Principles (S4-adopted goal-scoped, S18-adopted capability-scoped): re-verified each fresh, re-confirmed S5/S8/S19/S20 results, checked the two for conflict/duplication against each other, and re-applied both boundary rules to all 3 real trace chains

problem: Two independently-adopted Principles (S4, goal-scoped; S18, capability-scoped) had each separately passed operational validation and boundary validation on their own track, but had never been checked against EACH OTHER for evidence/scope conflict or simultaneous, contradictory application to the same real trace case -- readiness of the pair as a whole is not automatically implied by readiness of each part alone.

decision.decision_summary: P1 fresh evidence match=true, P2 fresh evidence match=true. S5=PRINCIPLE_OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED(ok=true), S8=PRINCIPLE_BOUNDARY_VALIDATED(ok=true), S19=PRINCIPLE_GUIDED_DECISION_CONFIRMED(ok=true), S20=PRINCIPLE_BOUNDARY_VALIDATED(ok=true). Cross-Principle conflict/duplication=false. All 3 real trace chains re-tested against both boundary rules: p1_correct=true, p2_correct=true, no_simultaneous_application=true, no_additional_untested_cases=true. 0 CI wiring, 0 automatic policy, 0 automatic execution, 0 real project modifications. Verdict: PRINCIPLES_OPERATIONALLY_READY.

action.action_summary: Re-derived both Principles' evidence groupings fresh from the canonical Experience Layer, re-read S5/S8/S19/S20's own final_state fresh, checked the two Principles' evidence and goal scope for overlap, and re-applied both unmodified boundary rules to all 3 real trace v16 chains to confirm complete, correct, non-overlapping coverage.

result.note: Both Principles independently re-verified and jointly checked for conflict/duplication: disjoint evidence, disjoint goal scope, and mutually exclusive, correct application across all 3 real trace chains -- the pair is operationally ready, still recorded read-only, not CI/policy/execution-wired.

cause.root_cause_summary: Each Principle passing its own operational-validation and boundary-validation track independently only proves each is internally coherent -- it says nothing about whether the two, applied together to the same real data, would ever fire on the same case in contradictory ways or silently share evidence; that joint claim requires its own explicit, mechanical check.

lesson: Readiness of a set of Principles is not the sum of each Principle's individual readiness -- it additionally requires a cross-Principle check run against the same real data both were validated on: disjoint evidence/scope, and no real case where both boundary rules would fire at once. Here that check confirmed the goal-scoped and capability-scoped Principles cover disjoint real cases (goal_production_runtime vs goal_semantic_quality) with goal_ghibli_production_pipeline correctly excluded by both -- a clean, non-overlapping partition of the 3 real trace chains, not an accident of the check never having been run.
